newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-GRIQUALAND WEST BEAT SOUTH WESTERN DISTRICTS 43-17.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-GRIQUALAND WEST BEAT SOUTH WESTERN DISTRICTS 43-17.

text.p: Griqualand West beat South Western Districts 43-17 (halftime 22-10) in a Currie Cup rugby match on Friday:
Griqualand West - Tries: Luther Bakkes (2), Franco Smith, Edrich Lubbe, Philip Smit, Gideon Watts. Conversions: Lubbe (5). Penalty: Lubbe
South Western Districts - Tries: Pine Pienaar, Braam van Straaten. Conversions: Van Straaten (2). Penalty: Van Straaten
